source.interpretation: REGENERATIVE is an OperationProfile initiation type for a fixed mission; successor sub-missions start before the predecessor's on-station phase ends so their on-station coverage can meet. IQTY and IQTYD must be empty.

exact_delta: SystemDeployment.QTYPS changes 1 to 2 and Unit.DESCR changes only a label.
MissionType.DURN changes 2 to 4 hours and MissionType.DESCR changes only a label; MPAT remains the parent's default FIXED, NOS=MNOS=1, TFOUT=TFRET=0.25, NOPER=1.
Three A02 scheduled OperationProfile rows at 8, 20 and 32 are replaced by one REGENERATIVE row at 8 with IPER=8, IQTY/IQTYD/DTIM empty.
ProblemDescription.PDESC changes a descriptive label. All 26 other source tables remain identical, including zero failure rate, seed and report horizon.

hand_timeline_hypothesis.coverage_hypothesis: Continuous on-station coverage from hour 9 to 15 if the fourth final sub-mission starts at 14 and immediately returns after reaching station. The native event order and terminal truncation decide whether that final zero-on-station sub-mission actually occurs.

predeclared_native_acceptance: One immutable guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID 13340 identity guard, source/raw SHA-256 seals, four CLI steps and exact row-containing source roundtrip.

Zero conversion errors; classify warnings. If the native converter rejects the fixed-mission regenerative profile, preserve the sealed probe and publish only the capability limit with its exact error code.

Require at least two distinct, successful, overlapping sub-missions with ordered OUT, ON STATION and BACK phases. Compare actual notification, departure, arrival, return and successor timestamps to the hand timeline; investigate any difference rather than changing the expected values retroactively.

Reconcile every event to 72 aligned half-hour system and stock bins, mission/system operating integrals, zero failure, repair and inventory activity, and two-aircraft terminal readiness. Check that child missions and report intervals have finite counts.
An independent read-only reviewer replays source delta and raw artifacts without importing the author validator.
limits: One fixed mission template, one no-failure seed and a nondegenerate eight-hour regeneration period; failure-driven early relief, zero on-station time and resource shortage require separate variants.

The manual's initiation and phase rules are source expectations, while the exact successor event order remains subject to native observation. GUI visual content and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
